sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 13 (A13=12, B13='B - task.toml & run wiring', C13=no_prebuilt_image_shadows_the_agent_dockerfile, D13 wording) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 13 (same id; D13 '...which would skip it entirely'; E13 empty, no extra annotation)
evidence: Frozen task/task.toml (sha256 15b097b6...bed, equal to manifest and to live projects/kittle-matter-chat/task.toml) has [environment] containing only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; a grep for 'docker_image' / 'image =' over the whole frozen task and the frozen template returns no match, so no prebuilt image is set anywhere ([environment], [verifier.environment] or elsewhere). The agent Dockerfile (task/environment/Dockerfile, sha256 0a75419e...67d1, byte-identical to the template Dockerfile hash in the manifest) has active build steps: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim (l.1), apt-get install ca-certificates git procps sqlite3 (l.5-7), npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (l.9-12), COPY instructions/ /instructions/ and COPY assets/ /assets/ (l.14-15), git init of /app (l.16-23). Because docker_image is absent, Harbor builds this Dockerfile, so these steps (including the /instructions and /assets copies the brief relies on) are live, not dead code. Matches the template's [environment] block (template task.toml l.20-24, also without docker_image) and staged-task-contract.md:78. Counterexample search: a task that set [environment].docker_image = <some prebuilt node image> would silently drop the asset COPYs and preinstalled express/better-sqlite3; that configuration is not present here. No conforming alternative can be harmed by this row since it is a pure static config property. Run note: this is a static configuration row; no runtime measurement is required for it. The raw-evidence index cites a golden run in an agent container, but I did not rely on it; full configured grading evidence remains absent per that index, which is outside this row's scope.
